parameters.name: category
parameters.description:
Categories that apps must have in order to be returned in the response. E.g. Accounting (`accounting`), AI Tools (`ai-tools`), and All (`all`).
The full list of valid categories can be retrieved using the `category` endpoint, detailed [here](https://platform.zapier.com/embed/partner-api#get-v1categories).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Parameter to restrict the results to apps whose ID matches those in the provided comma-separated value. Cannot be combined with `category`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Used for paginating results. Specifies the amount of apps to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Used for paginating results. Specifies the offset of the apps to return.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Parameter to limit the results to apps whose titles match the provided query.

projectedOperation.description:
This endpoint returns a list of popular apps.  Keep in mind that Zapier built-in apps will not be returned and the order of the result is by app popularity.

This endpoint requires the `zap` OAuth scope.

This API is rate limited by IP address (60 requests per min), or partner (150 requests per min), whichever occurs first.

200.description: A successful request to get available Authentications for the provided App.

projectedOperation.description:
Fetch the available Authentications for the provided App. This will only return Authentications that are owned by the user and not those that are shared with them, since it''s not possible to create Zaps with Authentications you don''t own.

This endpoint requires the `authentication` OAuth scope.

This API is rate limited by IP address (60 requests per min), or partner (150 requests per min), whichever occurs first.

requestBody.description: Inputs to create a new Authentication

projectedOperation.description:

This endpoint requires the `authentication:write` OAuth scope.

This API is rate limited by IP address (60 requests per min), or partner (150 requests per min), whichever occurs first.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Find Zap runs equal to or newer than this date. If not provided, results default to last 30 days' Zap Runs.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of returned Zap Runs.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of Zap Runs to skip.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Performs a text search against the `zap_title`, `data_in`, and `data_out` fields, returning only zap runs that match the specified keywords.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Accepts one or more status values separated by commas, enabling the filtering of zap runs based on the specified status or statuses provided.

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: Find Zap runs less than this date.

parameters.name: zap_id
parameters.description: Find Zap runs for the specified Zap ID.

projectedOperation.description:
This endpoint is a first version tool that delivers basic yet essential details about their executed Zap runs. As an evolving interface, this first version serves foundational information about Zap runs.

_However, it's important to note that this is an initial implementation and the **response payload is not definitive**. Our aim is to continually iterate and enhance this API, refining its capabilities and data output, to progressively deliver more valuable and useful information in future versions._

This endpoint requires the `zap:runs` OAuth scope.

This API is rate limited by IP address (60 requests per min), or partner (150 requests per min), whichever occurs first.

Please note that since this is an experimental tool, if you're interested in gaining access, you must contact our support team.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: A comma separated list of Zap fields that should be expanded from ids to full objects in the response. If a field may not be expanded, its encoded form will be returned instead.

parameters.name: inputs
parameters.description: You may pass inputs[KEY]=VALUE1,VALUE2 to filter for Zaps that contain those settings. For example, if your OAuth app is Trello you may filter for Zaps that contain a certain Trello board using inputs[board]=BOARD_ID — Keys are defined by your app on the developer platform.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Used for paginating results. Specifies the amount of apps to return

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Used for paginating results. Specifies the offset of the apps to return

projectedOperation.description:
This endpoint returns a list of Zaps for the authenticated Zapier user.

The `expand` array can be used to expand selected fields into full objects in the response.  Inputs with keys can also be passed to filter Zaps by certain criteria.

This endpoint requires the `zap` OAuth scope.

This API is rate limited by IP address (60 requests per min), or partner (150 requests per min), whichever occurs first.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: A comma separated list of Zap fields that should be expanded from ids to full objects in the response. If a field may not be expanded, its encoded form will be returned instead.

projectedOperation.description:
This URL creates a new Zap based on a series of steps and a given title. `is_enabled` must be set to true when creating a new Zap.

This endpoint requires the `zap:write` OAuth scope.

This API is rate limited by IP address (60 requests per min), or partner (150 requests per min), whichever occurs first.
